title: Dijasporac Production  - Videos
description:
Welcome to the Dijasporac Production channel.

We explore forgotten events and unique phenomena. What sets this channel apart is our process: we combine archival footage, licensed materials, and original graphic animations with our own storytelling to create a completely new and unique experience for our viewers.

Every video is an original work by the Dijasporac Production team, created with the goal of educating and encouraging critical thinking.

For collaborations and inquiries: dijasporacbih@gmail.com
